title: Eastern-Style Vegan Flatbread
description: A delicious and easy-to-make flatbread inspired by the flavors of the Middle East, now adapted to be vegan-friendly. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: middle eastern flatbread topping
ingredients.notes: can be found in most supermarkets or replaced with a mixture of olive oil, chopped herbs, and spices

ingredients.name: crisp lettuce
ingredients.notes: any variety of crisp lettuce works well

instructions: Place the flatbread on a baking sheet.
Brush the flatbread with the middle eastern flatbread topping.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the flatbread is crispy and the lettuce is slightly wilted.
